title: Chic Townhome for 8 w/Rooftop
description:
✔️ North Nashville location, minutes from downtown & Germantown
✔️ Rooftop deck with lounge seating, dining area & fire feature
✔️ 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths — sleeps up to 8
✔️ Foosball table, smart TVs & in-home laundry
✔️ Full kitchen, garage parking for 2 vehicles & WiFi

The space
• Blue Note Retreat — a modern townhouse with easy access to Nashville's top attractions
• Open-concept living, dining, and kitchen designed for gathering together
• Relax on the rooftop deck with skyline breezes, outdoor dining, and a tabletop fire feature
• Challenge friends to a game of foosball before settling in for a movie night
• Perfect for families, friends, business travelers, and longer stays

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Open living room with smart TV
• Rooftop deck with lounge seating
• Outdoor dining table
• Tabletop fire feature for relaxing evenings
• Foosball table
• Open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 8)
• This home includes 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms
• Bedroom 1 (1st Floor): Full-over-full bunk bed, smart TV; sleeps 4
• Bedroom 2 (3rd Floor-Primary): King bed, smart TV, ensuite bathroom; sleeps 2
• Bedroom 3 (3rd Floor): Queen bed, smart TV, ensuite bathroom; sleeps 2
Bathrooms
• Bathroom 1 (1st Floor): Single vanity, glass walk-in shower
• Bathroom 2 (2nd Floor): Shared half bathroom
• Bathroom 3 (3rd Floor Primary Ensuite): Dual vanity, walk-in shower
• Bathroom 4 (3rd Floor BD 3 Ensuite): Single vanity, shower/tub combo

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with refrigerator, stove/oven, microwave, and dishwasher
• Kitchen island with seating
• Dining table for shared meals
• Basic cookware, dishes, utensils, and serveware provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• Fresh bed linens and bath towels
• Starter supply of toiletries and paper goods
• In-home washer and dryer
• WiFi
• Smart TVs throughout the home

📍 Location Highlights
• Minutes from downtown Nashville
• Close to Germantown restaurants, breweries, and coffee shops
• Near Cumberland River Greenway
• Easy access to parks, entertainment, and Broadway

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Private attached garage parking is available for up to 2 vehicles.
• This home spans multiple levels, and stairs are required to access the main living areas and rooftop deck.
• This home is not pet friendly. If there is found evidence of an animal's presence during your stay or post check-out, guests will be charged an additional cleaning fee.
• Check in is at 4:00 PM and checkout is at 10:00 AM.
